feature: Deformable Ellipse periodic cubic output and point-count getter

profiles.comparison: Complete command/frontend NURBS geometry and actual history at 1e-6 for unique point counts 4,5,6,7,8,9,12,16 and bare Deformable input.

Complete command/frontend geometry, focus markers, source preservation, returned selection and actual history at 1e-6 across all construction modes, spatial/skew axes, radius locks, relative/CPlane input, owned Brep edge picking and explicit remembered-count/reset workflows.
Complete geometry/history at 1e-6 for the integer getter, Enter default, corrected minimum count and replacement point counts.
Clean native cancellation at the point-count and first-axis getters; complete input receipts and no output, with matching local cancellation cleanup.
Excluded from successful geometry qualification: six unknown-option attempts, two superseded prompt-adapter timeouts and one implicit inherited-count dependency.

qualifications: Deformable is enabled before the first point and applies to Default, Vertical, Diameter, Corner, centered Corner, FromFoci and AroundCurve. New invocations reset to exact output; successful commands remember point counts.

The captured native getter accepts PointCount and creates degree-three non-rational periodic curves. Counts are unique controls with three repeated seam aliases. Its fresh default is 12; native qualified cases span counts 4 through 64.

The geometry constructor samples equal angular ellipse stations and reuses the existing linear cyclic cubic interpolator. Canonical unused exterior knots and the semi-axis-diagonal domain match native output.

All controls, weights, knots, domains, lengths, focus-marker ordering, unchanged sources, returned selection and actual Undo/Redo compare through command and frontend on both backends for 33 successful workflows. This includes 32 cubic outputs and one explicit restart with analytic output.

The real PointCount integer getter accepts Enter defaults, replacement counts and a corrected count after rejecting three. Typed point counts are dimensionless. Complete scripts with a bare count option and space-separated coordinate triples retain correct parsing.

One public native Brep-edge viewport click has an owned authored-point acknowledgement receipt. Whole-curve and preselected AroundCurve cases preserve source storage and selection after the command returns.

Viewport previews draw the same deformable NURBS definition used by commits. Local tests cover locked-preview Enter, numeric axis locks, invalid counts and units, cancellation, one history step and remembered settings across Undo.

Local stale-guide resets preserve Deformable output while clearing old center/axes, filters and constraints. Replacement, deletion, visibility, locking and tolerance changes are checked before and after the center for exact and deformable output.

A local 1000-unique-point regression verifies control count and station interpolation; separate command/frontend checks verify periodic closure and unit weights. The supported local upper bound is 1000; native high-count and performance parity are not qualified.
source_selection_policy: AroundCurve after compares native after_script, the returned state. The earlier native EndCommand after temporarily retains a postselected whole guide. Returned/Undo/Redo snapshots release postselection, preserve preselection and leave picked edge parents unselected.

native_capture_provenance.purpose: Four exploratory Degree attempts: native command history rejects Degree and retains cubic output. All remain diagnostics.
Nine clean point-count/toggle workflows, two unknown-option diagnostics and one implicit-state default diagnostic.
Twenty clean mode/source/preference workflows. Two integer-prompt adapter timeouts are retained separately, with clean later recaptures.
Four complete integer-getter/replacement workflows and two clean cancellations after adding the observed public Deformable point count prompt prefix.

metric_policy: Thirty-three complete successful native workflows qualify at absolute 1e-6, with two no-output cancellations separate. All nine diagnostic rows retain their original actions and native observations unchanged. No geometry qualification is inferred from a successful result when command history contains Unknown command or the input trace is incomplete. Earlier 82 Ellipse workflows remain regression coverage.
unqualified: Degree selection: Rhino 8.32 rejects Degree and emits cubics despite the broader wording in its public help
Disabling Deformable after enabling it in the same invocation: native rejects that option
Native preference changes on cancellation: local pending count/marker changes save only after success
Native source-freshness behavior and exhaustive physical snapping/perspective/aperture parity
Native high-count behavior beyond the qualified 4-through-64 cases, extreme parameter ranges and performance parity
